environment.method: separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR per package, cold target directory, serial builds

notes: Both clean builds were measured from separate empty target directories.
The target sizes are dominated by wgpu/winit dependency artifacts, not the POC code.
The Slint build includes the .slint compiler and i-slint-* crates; the egui build includes egui/egui-wgpu/egui-winit.
First build times are within 4% of each other on this machine; the disk and dependency gap is much larger.
